The closest matches are papers on adaptive chunking and structure-aware retrieval for RAG. Intent-Driven Dynamic Chunking and SmartChunk both adapt chunk boundaries or abstraction levels to user queries, which can help a bot answer questions from long technical documents more accurately [1, 9]. LARAG, Adaptive Chunking, and the EDA function-aware retrieval paper go further by using document structure, metadata, or functional units to retrieve more relevant evidence from technical documentation [2, 3, 6].

For manuals specifically, AI-Friendly LaTeX and SMART focus on turning technical material into better retrieval units or structured facts, while the oil-and-gas study and engineering-manual model show that preserving domain structure improves retrieval or answer quality in manuals and similar documents [4, 5, 8].
